## How it was tested

- [ ] `make test` and `make lint` (backend)
- [ ] `make front/typecheck`, `make front/lint`, `make front/test` (web client)
- [ ] New strings exist in `en.json`, `fa.json` and `ar.json`
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or configuration changed
- [ ] `make swagger` run if a handler annotation changed
- [ ] I have read the contribution terms in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
